action_rejected: The operation could not be accepted. Please try again later.
automatic_calibration_description: When enabled, calibration runs automatically on the configured schedule (once or recurring). Calibration charges at the maximum allowed power; when PV output is insufficient it will purchase electricity from the grid, which may increase your electricity costs — we recommend scheduling it during a low-tariff period. We recommend calibrating about every 14 days.
automatic_calibration_offline_help: You can still configure automatic calibration while offline. It will run as scheduled when the device is back online; a scheduled run that remains offline will be marked as skipped and deferred.
automatic_calibration_running_help: Automatic calibration settings cannot be changed while calibration is running.
calibration_estimated_time: Calibration in Progress, Estimated Time Required: {num} min
calibration_progress_message: Force charging is in progress. Waiting for the battery to enter the charge-prohibited state.
estimated_remaining_hint: Estimated from the current SOC; actual duration may be longer.
first_calibration_time_must_be_future: First calibration time must be later than the current time.
grid_charged_energy: Of which grid-charged energy: {value} kWh · Meter-measured cumulative value
manual_calibration_description: Force charge the battery until charging is prohibited to complete an SOC calibration. We recommend calibrating about every 14 days. During calibration, charging uses the maximum available power and may purchase electricity from the grid when PV output is insufficient, which may increase your electricity costs.
manual_calibration_offline_warning: The device is offline. Calibration is temporarily unavailable.
next_calibration_estimate_once: Next calibration: {time}. It will run only once, then automatic calibration will be disabled.
next_calibration_estimate_periodic: Next calibration: {time}. It will repeat every {days} days.
no_permission: You do not have permission to perform this operation
parallel_calibration_notice: Master-follower parallel system: the SOC shown is station-level, and this calibration covers all paralleled units.
save_automatic_calibration_confirm: The automatic calibration schedule will be saved. Continue?
start_calibration_acknowledgement: I understand that calibration may purchase electricity from the grid and increase electricity costs.
start_calibration_confirm: Calibration is expected to take about {count} hours. During calibration, the system may purchase electricity from the grid.
start_calibration_confirm_without_estima: During calibration, the system may purchase electricity from the grid. The duration cannot currently be estimated.
start_calibration_description: The battery will be force-charged at the maximum permitted power until charging is prohibited.
start_calibration_estimate: Estimated duration: about {count} hours. The current SOC reading may be inaccurate, so the actual duration may be longer.
start_calibration_estimate_unavailable: The current SOC reading may be inaccurate, and the duration cannot currently be estimated.
start_calibration_grid_purchase_notice: When PV output is insufficient, electricity may be purchased from the grid, potentially increasing electricity costs.
start_calibration_suspend_notice: Current dispatching (including VPP dispatching) will be suspended and restored after calibration is complete.
station_soc_hint: This is the SOC for the parallel system.
stop_calibration_confirm: Stop the calibration currently in progress?
